case_order: Exact CASES.json order,205 rows; each exact keys q,n,marginal,joint,ratio,lower_bound,positive.
case_semantics: A=q^2-q+1,D=q^2+(q-1)^3,x=q^(n+1); p=(q-1)A^n/((x-1)q^n),J=(q-1)(D^n-A^n)/((x-1)(x-q)q^(n-1)),ratio=J/p^2,L=q(x-1)/((q-1)(x-q))*(1-(q/A)^n). Require ratio>L>=1; positive is strict boolean ratio>1.
rationals: Exact reduced integer pairs[numerator,denominator] with positive denominator. No float/bool-as-int aliases; duplicate/nonfinite JSON rejected.
receipt: Own primary receipt is common5-only; oracle may retain own metadata separately but peer comparison uses exact common5. Runtime source/cases/schema byte binding specified by each engine.
canonical: json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)),UTF8+LF. No matrix/field census; nonprimepowers are parameter-algebra fixtures only.
